notes.title: We have reached 1,000 copies sold!
notes.content: [p]It’s been a while, everyone.[/p][p]This time, Madoromi Travel has reached 1,000 copies sold![/p][p][/p][p]It seems that the boost in recognition from the release of our next title,[/p][p]and the distribution of download cards at Comic Market 106,[/p][p][/p][p]gave us a big push all at once.[/p][p]I’m very happy that we were able to deliver drowsiness to so many people.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s all thanks to your support.[/p][p]Thank you very much, and I look forward to your continued support.[/p][p]Kyuko[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905496/96da45eb1b9f4975d757c48c33dd14ae4b62c2ce.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: A new game has been released
notes.content: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a little over a year since まどろみトラベル, and I'm excited to share that we've just released a brand new game![/p][p][/p][p]It's called HauntedManager — a tower defense game with a higher focus on action compared to まどろみトラベル, but don't worry, there's also an easy mode for more relaxed play.[/p][p][/p][p]If you choose the "Intern" difficulty, you should be able to complete it in around 3 to 4 hours.[/p][p]This summer, why not try running a haunted house and enjoy some fun interactions with quirky ghosts along the way?[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3171480/HauntedManager/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: アップデート：不具合修正
notes.content:
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

・If you press "Start from the beginning of the stage" just before the game is over, the novel will be carried over and the game will be over even after restarting.

[h3]Chat[/h3]

It's been a month since the release.

Thanks to you, we have received "good reviews" on the store page.

We are also happy to see comments on streaming and SNS.

There are only a few bugs, so I think it will be a while before we get any updates.

(This means you can start working on the next game with peace of mind.)

Thank you for your continued support.

Kyuko

notes.title: リリースから1週間が経過しました
notes.content:
ローンチセールが終了しました。
購入、プレイして頂いた皆さま、本当にありがとうございます。

レビューも数件届いており、楽しく、かつ大切に読ませて頂いております。
(とても勉強になります……！)

Steamでは初のゲームリリースでしたが
報告されているバグは1,2件であり、致命的なモノも無いようで安心。

もう少し様子を見て、まとめてアップデート実施予定です。

フィードバックを糧に、もっと面白く上手に世界観を描けるよう努めていきますね。
引き続きよろしくお願いします。
Kyuko

notes.title: Announcement of the Release of "Madoromi Travel"!
notes.content:
The title "魔女の脳" is an 旧古 one. "まどろみトラベル" has been released.

With the release, you can purchase it at a 15% discount for a while.
Wouldn't it be fun to have a Golden Week where you fight against drowsiness for about 1 or 2 hours?

[h3]Distribution, etc.[/h3]
Feel free to distribute and create gameplay videos, including monetization.

[h3]Bugs, etc.[/h3]
Please report any bugs or issues here:
[url=https://twitter.com/kyuko4437]https://twitter.com/kyuko4437[/url]

[h3]If you enjoyed it[/h3]
It seems that if you could leave a review, it would be more likely to be featured in the store's recommendations.
If you have the time, I would be delighted if you could write one.
